custom_preconds: Custom role with Work Orders: View ON, Invoicing & Payments: Create & Edit ON, and See Financial Data ON — but Work Orders: Create & Edit OFF. A work order in an editable (non-invoiced, non-paid) status exists.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the custom-role user described in preconditions.
custom_steps_separated.expected: User reaches the app and can open a work order.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open a work order detail (left section shows the Financial Info card).
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Financial Info card renders (See Financial Data ON).

custom_steps_separated.content: Locate the Financial Info card edit (pencil) control.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The edit control (button_edit_financial_info) is visible and usable — Invoicing: Create & Edit grants "manage invoice fields" (spec §1h), so shop-supplies charge + tax are editable even without Work Orders: Create & Edit.

title: Invoicing: Create & Edit grants the Financial Info edit control on a WO (SV-8086)
